<!doctype html><html lang="zh-Hant"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>歷史政治實體年代圖</title>
<style>body{font:16px system-ui;margin:22px;background:#f7f8fa;color:#172536}h1{font-size:23px}label{margin-right:16px}input[type=range]{width:min(70vw,800px)}canvas{width:100%;aspect-ratio:2;border:1px solid #9eb0c3;background:#eaf2fa}#list{max-height:180px;overflow:auto;columns:3}button{display:block;border:0;background:none;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;padding:3px;color:#145789}#info{white-space:pre-wrap}small{display:block;margin:10px 0}</style>
<h1>歷史政治實體年代圖：來源重建疆域</h1>
<p>Cliopatria / Seshat Global History Databank，CC BY 4.0。此圖保留來源年代範圍，呈現其中一套歷史重建；不代表已核定疆界、勢力強弱或所有曾存在的國家。</p>
<label>年份 <input id="year" type="number" min="-3400" max="2024" value="1800"></label><input id="slider" aria-label="年份滑桿" type="range" min="-3400" max="2024" value="1800" step="1"><br>
<label>名稱 <input id="search" placeholder="輸入名稱，例如 Roman"></label><label><input id="relations" type="checkbox">加入RELATION關係層</label><span id="count"></span>
<small>負數依來源表示BCE，正數CE；不解讀來源未定義的年0。等經緯度投影非等面積。顯示幾何以0.15度容差簡化、座標取四位小數；未簡化完整資料另存。顏色只區分名稱，不表示國力；未繪區域為資料未覆蓋，不能視為無主地。</small>
<canvas id="map" width="1440" height="720" aria-label="選定年代的來源疆域圖"></canvas><p id="info">點選圖形或名稱以查看來源時段。</p><div id="list"></div>
<p><a href="https://github.com/Seshat-Global-History-Databank/cliopatria">來源與疆界不確定性說明</a> · <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">授權</a></p>
<script>const DATA=__PAYLOAD__;
const canvas=document.getElementById('map'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),year=document.getElementById('year'),slider=document.getElementById('slider'),search=document.getElementById('search'),relations=document.getElementById('relations'),list=document.getElementById('list'),info=document.getElementById('info');let visible=[],paths=new Map(),selected='';
function path(r){if(paths.has(r[0]))return paths.get(r[0]);let p=new Path2D();for(let poly of r[5])for(let ring of poly){ring.forEach((pt,i)=>{let x=(pt[0]+180)*4,y=(90-pt[1])*4;if(i)p.lineTo(x,y);else p.moveTo(x,y)});p.closePath()}paths.set(r[0],p);return p}
function color(name){let h=0;for(let ch of name)h=(h*31+ch.charCodeAt(0))>>>0;return `hsl(${h%360},55%,58%)`}
function describe(r){selected=r[0];info.textContent=`${r[1]} · ${r[2]}\n來源時段 ${r[3]} 至 ${r[4]}；記錄 ${r[0]}\n來源重建疆界；獨立實質核實待完成。`;draw()}
function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,1440,720);ctx.strokeStyle='#c9d7e7';ctx.lineWidth=1;for(let x=0;x<=1440;x+=120){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,720);ctx.stroke()}for(let y=0;y<=720;y+=120){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(1440,y);ctx.stroke()}for(let r of visible){ctx.globalAlpha=r[2]==='RELATION'?.18:.6;ctx.fillStyle=color(r[1]);ctx.fill(path(r),'evenodd');ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.strokeStyle=r[0]===selected?'#000':'#506071';ctx.lineWidth=r[0]===selected?3:.5;ctx.stroke(path(r))}}
function update(){let v=Math.max(-3400,Math.min(2024,Number(year.value)||0));year.value=v;slider.value=v;let q=search.value.trim().toLowerCase();visible=DATA.filter(r=>r[3]<=v&&r[4]>=v&&(relations.checked||r[2]==='POLITY')&&r[1].toLowerCase().includes(q));if(!visible.some(r=>r[0]===selected)){selected='';info.textContent='點選圖形或名稱以查看來源時段。'}document.getElementById('count').textContent=`${visible.length} 個來源時段記錄`;list.replaceChildren();for(let r of visible){let b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=r[1]+' ['+r[0]+']';b.onclick=()=>describe(r);list.appendChild(b)}draw()}
year.oninput=update;slider.oninput=()=>{year.value=slider.value;update()};search.oninput=update;relations.onchange=update;canvas.onclick=e=>{let box=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-box.left)*1440/box.width,y=(e.clientY-box.top)*720/box.height;for(let r of [...visible].reverse())if(ctx.isPointInPath(path(r),x,y,'evenodd')){describe(r);break}};update();
</script></html>
